title: Class Inheritance Chain (C++)
description: Create a base class Animal and derived classes Mammal and Dog. Gradually add members.

title: Static Functions and Members (C++)
description: Demonstrate static fields and static member functions.

title: Encapsulation with Getters/Setters (C++)
description: Create a Person class with private fields and public accessor methods.

title: Abstract Class and Virtual Method (C++)

description: Create a Vehicle interface using a pure abstract class, then implement Car and Bike.

title: Multiple Inheritance with Virtual Base (C++)
description: Demonstrate diamond problem and resolve with virtual inheritance.
